# Style 04 · Organic Earth

> Grown, not manufactured.

**Keywords:** Natural · Warm · Honest · Calm · Crafted  
**Mood:** Natural · Calm · Warm  
**Sectors:** Beauty & wellness · Food & beverage · Hospitality & travel · Retail & FMCG  
**Strongest applications:** Packaging · Social media · Websites · Brand identity · Print & editorial

> **Fictional sample brand.** Fernhollow, botanical skincare, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Organic Earth uses soft natural forms, plant-derived colours and a warm serif to signal care, provenance and honesty. Layouts feel hand-arranged rather than engineered, and texture matters as much as colour.

## Target industries

- Natural skincare and wellness
- Organic food and beverage
- Sustainable home goods
- Yoga, retreats and eco-tourism
- Farm-to-table restaurants
- Plant shops and florists

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Oat | `#E9E4D8` | Primary background | 50% |
| Moss | `#3F4F35` | Text, deep sections | 22% |
| Sage | `#A3B18A` | Secondary surfaces | 14% |
| Clay Rose | `#C98F7E` | Accent: actions, highlights | 8% |
| Bark | `#4A3B30` | Secondary text on light | 6% |

**Rule:** Every colour should exist in nature. Pair Moss and Oat for text, and keep Clay Rose for calls to action and small highlights.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Fraunces** | 400, 600 · soft optical size | Headlines, product names |
| Body | **Karla** | 400, 500 | Body, UI, ingredients lists |
| Arabic | **Tajawal (body) · Reem Kufi Fun (display)** | | Rounded, friendly Arabic forms keep the hand-made feel. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 64 / 70 | 400 | Sentence case, soft optical size |
| H1 | 42 / 50 | 400 | Italic for one key word |
| H2 | 24 / 32 | 600 | Sentence case |
| Body | 17 / 28 | 400 | Comfortable line height |
| Label | 13 / 18 | 500 | Sentence case, never all caps |

- Keep headlines in sentence case. Caps feel clinical here.
- Write in a warm, first-person plural voice: we grow, we pick.
- List ingredients in the body font with their origin.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 32px gutter · loose asymmetric placement
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Large rounded containers with 40px padding.
- **Corners:** 24px containers · full pill buttons · organic blob masks on images

- Mask images with soft blob or pebble shapes.
- Overlap leaves or botanicals across section edges.
- Use paper grain texture at low opacity on backgrounds.
- Group content in rounded, softly tinted containers.
- Keep a slow vertical rhythm with plenty of air.

## Photography direction

Ingredients, hands and landscapes in soft daylight with earthy tones.

- Raw ingredients as hero subjects: roots, leaves, oils.
- Hands at work: picking, pouring, applying.
- Natural light, slight warmth, gentle shadows.
- Textured surfaces: wood, stone, linen, soil.
- Real skin, no heavy retouching.

**Sample shot list**

1. Hands pouring oil over sage leaves (grade: `#C9CFB5` → `#8E9A73` → `#3F4F35`)
2. Amber bottle on wet river stone (grade: `#D8C7B2` → `#A07D63` → `#4A3B30`)
3. Fern field at morning, soft haze (grade: `#DCE2CC` → `#A3B18A` → `#56664A`)

**Avoid**

- Cold blue lighting
- Sterile white studio backgrounds
- Plastic packaging close-ups

## Graphic elements

- Organic blob and pebble shapes
- Line-drawn botanical illustrations
- Paper grain and recycled-paper textures
- Stamp-style badges: Certified organic, Vegan
- Hand-drawn underlines in Clay Rose

## UI examples

- Pill buttons in Moss. Primary actions in Clay Rose.
- Rounded inputs with a Sage tint and no hard border.
- Product cards with a pebble-shaped image mask.
- Gentle 300ms transitions, nothing snappy.

- Primary button: `Shop the ritual` · Secondary button: `Our ingredients`
- Input: Skin type: `Combination`
- Tags: `Vegan` `Cold-pressed` `Refillable`
- Card: **Sage & Rosehip Oil**, 30 ml · Glass bottle, 28 EUR

## Social media examples

- Mix product shots with ingredient stories and behind-the-scenes.
- Use the blob shape as a consistent frame across the grid.
- Captions read like a conversation, never a sales pitch.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | From our garden | Rosehip, picked by hand in October. |  |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | Morning ritual | Three drops. That's it. | Shop now |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | New · Refill pouch | Less plastic, same glow. | Shop refills |

## Website example

- Hero with a blob-masked product image and a soft serif headline.
- Ingredient stories as alternating rounded sections.
- Sustainability facts as stamp badges.

- **Navigation:** Shop · Ingredients · Our farm
- **Hero eyebrow:** Botanical skincare
- **Hero headline:** Skincare grown, not made.
- **Hero copy:** Cold-pressed oils from our own farm, bottled in glass and shipped plastic-free.
- **Actions:** Shop the ritual / Visit the farm
- **Proof row:** Farm grown (80% of ingredients from our fields.) · Plastic-free (Glass bottles and compostable mailers.) · Small batch (Pressed every six weeks.)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** From Our Fields

Each execution names the field an ingredient came from and the month it was harvested.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | Fernhollow · Field 7 | Rosehip, picked by hand in October. | fernhollow.example |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Refills that skip the plastic. | Shop |

- Print on uncoated or recycled stock, and say so on the ad.
- Book transit near wellness venues, organic grocers and yoga studios.
- Banner motion is a slow leaf drift or pour, under 8 seconds.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Retail partner deck · **Grown, not made.** · Fernhollow for natural retailers
- **Content slide:** Why it sells through. Key figure **80%** (of ingredients from our own fields); points: Glass, refillable packaging; Small batches every six weeks; Story-led shelf display. Figures are sample data.

- Rounded image masks on generous Oat backgrounds.
- Ingredient photography between sections.
- Slide titles are sentences, never all caps.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Maren Holt**, Head of Retail (`maren@fernhollow.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Packaging | amber glass, uncoated label, line-drawn botanical, Clay Rose batch stamp |
| Shipping | kraft mailer, stamp-style seal, compostable tape |
| Retail | wooden shelf, linen backdrop, hand-lettered price cards |
| Market stall | Moss canopy with certification stamps |

- Labels print on uncoated stock, so check colour on the real paper.
- Botanical drawings are single-weight line art, never filled.
- Certification badges follow the issuing body's rules, not the brand palette.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use real texture | Neon or synthetic colours |
| Show where things come from | Hard geometric grids |
| Round every corner | All-caps headlines |

## Design tokens

Text in the accent colour uses `--avdl-accent-text`, which passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both `bg` and `surface`.

```css

  --avdl-bg: #E9E4D8;
  --avdl-surface: #F3F0E8;
  --avdl-ink: #3F4F35;
  --avdl-muted: #4A3B30;
  --avdl-accent: #C98F7E;
  --avdl-accent-text: #874B3B;
  --avdl-accent-2: #A3B18A;
  --avdl-on-accent: #2C2420;
  --avdl-line: #A3B18A;
  --avdl-font-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
  --avdl-font-body: 'Karla', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-display-weight: 400;
  --avdl-display-case: none;
  --avdl-display-tracking: -0.01em;
  --avdl-radius: 24px;
  --avdl-button-radius: 999px;
  --avdl-border-width: 1px;
  --avdl-shadow: none;
  --avdl-color-oat: #E9E4D8;
  --avdl-color-moss: #3F4F35;
  --avdl-color-sage: #A3B18A;
  --avdl-color-clay-rose: #C98F7E;

}
```
